_comment: Stage-1 main campaign. Blocked randomization: each repetition visits the netem profiles in random order and runs all cells of a profile in random order. 5 reps x 10 domains x 10 queries = 500 queries per cell. The legacy variant (the old bug) is only needed at lan and rtt50, unpadded. Run inside tmux; check `--dry-run` first.
